native.document:
openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: Forecasts API
  version: 2.0.0
  description: Synthetic demo API.
  x-audience: internal
paths:
  /forecasts/{region}:
    get:
      operationId: getForecast
      summary: Get a forecast
      deprecated: false
      parameters:
        - name: region
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A forecast.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Forecast'
    post:
      summary: Submit an observation
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Accepted.
components:
  schemas:
    Forecast:
      type: object
      properties:
        region: {type: string}
        owner: {type: string}
